title: Transfer bounded decision and evidence context across commitment changes
goal: Let a successor continue valid work from the relevant decisions, questions and evidence without rereading the full session or inheriting another role’s hidden context.
scope: Create Handoff on Released, Delegated, Expired and a new contribution for the same WorkItem, retaining from/to, subject and ContextDigest decisions/open_questions/evidence/summary. Use durable journal refs rather than copied authoritative records.

Build the default JournalDigest without inference, scoped to the successor’s assignment targets and permitted visibility. If insufficient, admit a bounded cheap Narrator contribution with a stated need and receipt; model condensation is never a hidden coordination call.

Compose the next assignment prompt with selected criteria, visible checks, handoff and relevant decision history. Account for native thread reuse: continuing the same agent identity does not authorize exposure of its previous role’s hidden context.
Make missing/corrupted/stale references and unresolved external effects explicit; carry completed evidence and pending questions without implying the predecessor’s work was accepted or undone.
acceptance: Through real release, delegation and expiry/reassignment flows, a successor receives the relevant completed decisions, failed checks and open questions, and can continue the WorkItem without the full history.

Hidden checks, another participant’s sealed result and previous-role native context are absent from the successor prompt/tool access. A broken evidence ref is surfaced rather than replaced with invented detail.

JournalDigest and a materially different admitted Narrator-assisted ContextComposer path run through actual execution; only the latter creates a paid invocation. Replay does not duplicate HandoffCreated or discard retained accepted results.
context: Authority: ymp-docs/self-organizing-team-domain-model.md, sections 3.5 (Handoff, ContextDigest), 5.7 (ContextComposer), P5, A5 and R-8/R-10/R-16. Use the approved model with 811a872 semantics and the greenfield baseline in 0c61ff1 and §5.8 for experimental strategy boundaries. Other documents and existing names explain implementation facts only.

Greenfield: create this behavior in the new implementation. Paths below are PROPOSED target modules under the layout owned by W1-0001; only completed prerequisite tasks supply implementation. Prior source, APIs, fixtures and delivery claims are not a baseline.

Create Handoff/ContextDigest behavior in proposed kernel coordination and runtime/policies/context.rs. W1-0007 supplies transition facts, W3-0003 reawards work and W3-0004 revises plans; W1-0013 supplies ContextComposer.

JournalDigest normally condenses relevant permitted refs without inference. A necessary Narrator-assisted handoff is Coordination paid from unprotected resources, not A11 Reporting reserve, and cannot run after user stop without continuation authority.

A new assignment keeps agent identity but not prior role/grant/hidden-context authority. Native session reuse must honor actual context visibility; missing references/uncertain external effects remain explicit. Persist one attributable HandoffCreated per transition.
